import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price colored by 4K capability
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
colors = ['#ff7f0e' if x == 1 else '#1f77b4' for x in df['has_video_4k']]
ax2.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], c=colors, alpha=0.5, s=30)
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#ff7f0e', label='4K Video'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#1f77b4', label='No 4K Video')]
ax2.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# 3. Camera releases over time by brand (top 5 brands)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().head(5).index
df_top_brands = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)]
brand_year_counts = df_top_brands.groupby(['model_year', 'brand']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
brand_year_counts.plot(kind='line', ax=ax3, marker='o', linewidth=2)
ax3.set_title('Camera Releases Over Time (Top 5 Brands)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Models', fontsize=11)
ax3.legend(title='Brand', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Body type distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set3', len(body_counts))
ax4.pie(body_counts.values, labels=body_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=colors_pie)
ax4.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Weight vs Price by body type
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
for body_type in body_types:
    data = df[df['body_type'] == body_type]
    ax5.scatter(data['weight_grams'], data['price_usd'], label=body_type, alpha=0.6, s=40)
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Price by Body Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Body Type', fontsize=9, loc='upper right')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Average specifications by sensor type
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
sensor_stats = df.groupby('sensor_type').agg({
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'max_iso': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
x_pos = np.arange(len(sensor_stats))
width = 0.35
ax6_twin = ax6.twinx()
bars1 = ax6.bar(x_pos - width/2, sensor_stats['megapixels'], width, 
                label='Avg Megapixels', color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax6_twin.bar(x_pos + width/2, sensor_stats['max_iso']/1000, width, 
                     label='Avg Max ISO (×1000)', color='coral', alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10, color='steelblue')
ax6_twin.set_ylabel('Max ISO (×1000)', fontsize=10, color='coral')
ax6.set_title('Avg Specs by Sensor Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax6.set_xticklabels(sensor_stats['sensor_type'], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='steelblue')
ax6_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='coral')
lines1, labels1 = ax6.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax6_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax6.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', fontsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Specifications Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
